what: Proto3d first-person camera. The eye sits at the back of the party's square, looking forward with a fixed vertical FOV. Monsters are drawn monsterOffsetTowardParty tiles in front of their square centre, toward the party (Eye of the Beholder style). Pixelartie: size close/near/mid/far frames from unitSpriteHeightPx (1 world-unit-tall floor-anchored billboard) or wallSpriteHeightPx (1 wall = cellSize world units). wallPx = 2 * f / z with f = (viewH/2)/tan(fov/2) and z = (squares + backOffsetTiles - monsterOffsetTowardParty) * cellSize. Monster worldHeight in levels/monsters.json is a fraction of one wall. Idle poses share the tallest pose's canvas, so they measure about 86–95% of these targets — do not scale sprites up to compensate.
